thread:
ellie: Quick q — routing failures: what do we show clients vs keep internal? I'm thinking 425 vs 429 vs 503 mapping and how the console links to runbooks.
jordan: Today it's a bit ad hoc. 503 for route capacity, 429 for tenant quota, and some weird 425 for warmup/timeouts. messy.
maya: 425 is risky; it's not commonly parsed by clients. most expect 429 for anything retryable due to throttling.
rafa: Proposal: unify around a small set of surface codes + header-level reasons.
  - tenant_quota -> 429 + Retry-After
  - route_capacity/unavailable -> 503 + X-RW-Fail: capacity
  - model_exec_error -> 500 + X-RW-Fail: model
  - backpressure_degraded -> 503 (degraded) with 'degraded' badge in console
sam: Also add a structured header that SDKs can use: `X-RW-Fail` (enum: quota, capacity, model, degen), and `X-RW-Retry-Hint` (none|short|long).
niki: From console POV: for `capacity` we want a 'degraded routes' badge that links to a runbook and shows affected route IDs + last 100 traces sample. CTA should be 'View runbook' or 'Request more capacity'.
deploy-bot: heads up: there's a canary scheduled Thu that touches status mappings — expect brief spike in test traffic.
ops-bot: incident-note: last month we had 2 incidents where clients misinterpreted 425 as permanent. telemetry shows retries dropped 40%.
maya: Telemetry: event schema needs route_id, model_id, tenant_hash (not raw tenant_id), fail_code, sdk_version. Keep PII out.
jordan: Client copy idea (short and actionable): "Request delayed due to capacity. Retry after N seconds or reduce batch size." include `retry_after` numeric in JSON body for SDKs to read.
rafa: Example headers we can standardize:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Retry-After: 5
X-RW-Fail: capacity
X-Request-ID: rq_123
```
ellie: Should we include a runbook pointer header like `X-RW-Runbook-ID`? I prefer ID over URL to avoid leaking internal links.
sam: SDKs can map runbook IDs to console URLs when auth present. that keeps surface minimal and safe.
niki: UX: show consolidated badge on the tenant dashboard, with an inline tooltip: "Capacity pressure on route X — estimated recovery 3min" and a quick link to throttle advice.
maya: Also: deprecation plan — we're retiring the 425 usage. Need migration window (30 days) + feature flaged rollout + telemetry to show remaining clients hitting 425.
jordan: We should add a lightweight migration header when serving old-style 425 for a while: `X-RW-Deprecation: mapping-change; will-return-429=YYYY-MM-DD`.
ellie: I'll draft an RFC covering: status mappings, header schema, telemetry schema, console badges/runbook linkage, SDK behavior, and rollout plan with flags. @sam @niki can you review when ready? :thumbsup:
sam: happy to. will add SDK compatibility notes.
niki: Will mock up badge and runbook UX tomorrow.
ellie: perfect — thanks all. I'll post the RFC link here when it's ready.
